```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
df <- read.csv("healthcare_dataset.csv")
```

How many unique values are there for each variable 
```{r}
df_cols <- names(df) 

print(paste0("There are ", nrow(df), " rows in this dataset"))

count_unique <- function(df,var) {
  df |>
    select({{var}}) |>
    distinct() |>
    nrow()
}

for (col in df_cols) {
  print(paste0(col, " has ", count_unique(df, col), " unique values"))
}
```
